**Beta.** An **unofficial**, read-only reader for an Obsidian vault on a jailbroken Kindle. Not affiliated with or supported by Obsidian. Used so far on one device and one vault. Please read ["Read this before you use it"](https://github.com/agarciab28/kindle-vault#read-this-before-you-use-it) first.

## Install

1. Download `vault.zip` below and unzip it. You get a file, `Vault.sh`, and a folder, `vault-app`.
2. Connect the Kindle by USB and copy **both** into its `documents` folder.
3. Eject the Kindle and open **Vault** from the library.
4. In the app: sign in to Obsidian, then choose which vault to read.

Needs a jailbroken Kindle with the KindleModding hotfix (if KOReader or kTerm open from your library, you have it) and an Obsidian Sync subscription. Tested on a Paperwhite 12th gen, firmware 5.20.2. The interface is in English or Spanish.
